case.case_subtitle: See how the Atlas goes from a rare disease to a research question and next steps.
case.cause_summary: SCAR16 is associated with changes in both copies of the STUB1 gene. STUB1 provides instructions for making CHIP, a protein that helps cells manage damaged or misfolded proteins.
case.research_goal: We are looking for other diseases that affect some of the same cellular systems, because research from those diseases may help answer questions that have not yet been studied directly in SCAR16.

phenotype_groups.label: Movement and balance
phenotype_groups.detail: Progressive difficulty with balance, walking, coordination and speech is central to SCAR16.

phenotype_groups.label: Nervous system
phenotype_groups.detail: Some people also have stiffness, brisk reflexes, seizures or other movement symptoms.

phenotype_groups.label: Thinking and learning
phenotype_groups.detail: Cognitive changes occur in some people, but are not present in everyone.

phenotype_groups.label: Hormone-related features
phenotype_groups.detail: A subset of people have hypogonadotropic hypogonadism; it is not required for a SCAR16 diagnosis.

case.variation_note: SCAR16 can look different from one person to another, and age at onset ranges from infancy to adulthood in reported series.

guided_path.label: Lafora Disease
guided_path.meaning: A rare neurological disease connected here through evidence about downstream stress-response biology.

parent_certainty.label: Promising but unconfirmed
parent_certainty.explanation: Evidence supports a specific downstream biological connection, but the same functional defect has not been directly compared across both diseases.
parent_certainty.expert_review: This interpretation has not yet been approved by a disease specialist.

parent_gap: We still do not know whether SCAR16 and Lafora Disease produce the same type of cellular stress-response failure.
parent_gap_importance: If both diseases fail at the same cellular step, researchers may be able to reuse some of the same assays or experimental approaches.
